skill.description: Guides FastAPI hang triage with py-spy stack capture, localhost smoke tests, and a non-blocking ThreadPoolExecutor shutdown pattern.
skill.summary: Debug FastAPI event-loop hangs caused by blocking executor shutdown.
skill.author: BenderFendor

security_audit.summary: Most markdown backtick findings are false positives for inline tool names, file paths, or Python code snippets. Confirmed risks remain for local process reconnaissance, /proc inspection, and py-spy process dumps, especially sudo execution of a virtualenv binary. No prompt injection language was found.

remediation.issue: Privileged py-spy execution from a project virtualenv
remediation.suggestion: Avoid sudo execution of binaries inside project virtualenvs. Use a trusted system package or document least-privilege tracing setup with explicit approval.
Require explicit user approval before process enumeration, socket inspection, or /proc access. Scope commands to a confirmed PID.
Replace the absolute /home/bender path with a placeholder and explain how users should locate their approved tool path.
Separate installation from incident steps and require consent before installing diagnostic tools on shared or production systems.

content.value_statement: FastAPI stream endpoints can freeze when worker threads block the event loop. This skill gives a focused triage and executor shutdown fix.
actual_capabilities: Guides localhost health checks with curl timeouts for FastAPI services.
Uses py-spy stack dumps to identify blocking ThreadPoolExecutor shutdown frames.
Explains how to inspect uvicorn listener state and file descriptor counts.
Recommends a long-lived executor with non-blocking shutdown and canceled futures.
Provides a retest checklist for stream aborts and health endpoint responsiveness.
limitations: Focused on one FastAPI news stream hang pattern.
Requires safe access to the target backend process.
Does not replace full profiling, tracing, or load testing.
Commands need review before use on production hosts.

use_cases.title: Restore FastAPI Health Responses
use_cases.description: Trace why root or health endpoints stop responding while stream traffic is active.

use_cases.title: Capture Live Hang Evidence
use_cases.description: Collect stack evidence from uvicorn workers before changing concurrency code.

use_cases.title: Review Executor Shutdown Fixes
use_cases.description: Validate that stream routes cancel pending work and avoid blocking shutdown calls.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Hang Triage
prompt_templates.scenario: You need first checks for a local FastAPI hang.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to check whether my FastAPI app is hanging on root and health endpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Stack Capture Review
prompt_templates.scenario: You have approval to inspect a local uvicorn process.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me collect and interpret a py-spy stack dump for a uvicorn worker that stops responding.

prompt_templates.title: Executor Fix Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: You are ready to edit the stream route.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my stream route and propose a non-blocking ThreadPoolExecutor shutdown pattern with cancellation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Production-Safe Debug Runbook
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a careful runbook for shared systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a cautious runbook for diagnosing a FastAPI SSE hang, including command approval points and rollback checks.

output_examples.input: My FastAPI health endpoint times out during stream traffic.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a triage path: reproduce timeout, inspect listener state, capture stacks, then identify blocking shutdown frames.

output_examples.input: I need to fix a stream route that blocks after client disconnects.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends moving executor lifetime outside the context manager, canceling pending work, and using non-blocking shutdown.

output_examples.input: I want to verify the backend after the fix.
output_examples.output: The skill provides checks for health responses, aborted stream behavior, and stack dumps without blocking executor frames.

best_practices: Ask before running sudo, process inspection, or package installation commands.
Capture evidence before editing backend concurrency code.
Retest health endpoints and stream abort behavior after each change.
anti_patterns: Do not run privileged diagnostics on production hosts without approval.
Do not assume every timeout is caused by ThreadPoolExecutor shutdown.
Do not leave long-running RSS workers without network timeouts.

faq.question: What problem does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets FastAPI hangs caused by blocking executor shutdown in a server-sent events stream route.

faq.question: Does it require py-spy?
faq.answer: The runbook uses py-spy for live stack evidence, but users must approve process inspection first.

faq.question: Can it diagnose every FastAPI performance issue?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on one event-loop hang pattern and related executor cleanup behavior.

faq.question: Why does executor shutdown matter?
faq.answer: A blocking shutdown can wait on worker threads and freeze the event loop during client disconnects.

faq.question: Is it safe to run the commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. Process inspection, package installation, and sudo commands need explicit user approval.

faq.question: What should I verify after the fix?
faq.answer: Verify health responses, stream abort behavior, and stack dumps without blocking shutdown frames.
